items.question: According to WHO guidance on COVID-19 in the UAE, for how many seconds should you wash your hands with soap and water?
items.fact: Wash hands at least 20 seconds with soap and water

items.question: What are the three main symptoms of COVID-19 (2019 novel coronavirus) listed by WHO in the UAE government guidance?
items.fact: Main COVID-19 symptoms: dry cough, fever, tiredness
